scope: Observed MH4U EUR source assets; bounded parser, not a complete engine/file-format implementation

arc.header: <4sHHI; magic ARC\0, observed version19, count at6; records start12

record.0x48: uncompressed size low28 bits, high4 preserved unknown
record.0x4c: offset u32 relative to ARC start

arc.payload: zlib stream; validate exact output length/eof/no trailing bytes

primitive_fields.0x04: material ID in bits12..23; remaining bits preserved
primitive_fields.0x1c: strip extent u32; observed importer reads extent+1 u16

vertex_observed_type4_stride28.0x0c: 3 signed-normalized i8 normals; fourth byte preserved in raw source
vertex_observed_type4_stride28.0x18: joint/weight bytes; not used in static preview

mod.faces: u16 triangle strips; 0xffff restart; parity toggles on every new triangle including degenerates; omit only degenerate triples; validate local indices
unknowns: primitive flags and distinction between primitives0/1

tex.word4: version bits0..11=165; bits12..23 unknown; bits24..27 size shift; high nibble observed2
tex.word8: mip_count bits0..5; width bits6..18; height bits19..31
tex.word12: texture_count low8=1; color_type bits8..15=12; remaining bits preserved
tex.mip_offsets: u32 array at16, offsets relative to end of offset table in selected assets
tex.blocks: 16 bytes: alpha u64 little-endian then ETC1 selector u32LE then color/header u32LE
tex.alpha: 4-bit nibble at index4*(4*x+y), scaled by17; semantic purpose unknown
tex.rgb: ETC1 individual/differential modes; 8 standard modifier tables; clamp output0..255
tex.output_orientation: PPM/PNG top-down y0 equals source tile y0; OBJ UV untouched, so viewer image sampling uses y=(1-v)*height
tex.validation: 32768 RGB pixels identical to independent historical importer decoder

material_binding.observation: Both one133.mrl and sld133.mrl first resource name weapon\one\one133\one133_BM
material_binding.header: MRL\0 version32; first section offset u32 at0x14
material_binding.limitation: Other material expressions/state unparsed; display is unlit RGB preview

selection.reason: One material and one joint in each model; shared texture named by MRL. Other primitives retained as facts in manifest.
